content.comment_body: Hello! Why is this happening, and how can it be fixed? [product_name] [version_no] is installed. When I open a program originally made in [product_name][version_no], but later modified and saved with [product_name][version_no], the copy-paste of blocks works as expected, and the following information appears: *** 4/22/24, 2:59 AM [product_name] [version_no]_1 Diagram *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** Paste from clipboard (Only texts can be copied) Blocks with updated properties: M1 [Flag]: M17 --> M1 B001 [NOT]: B006 --> B001 On another project, created directly in [product_name] [version_no], copy-paste fails, even when copying the same items. The info window displays: *** 4/22/24, 3:01 AM [product_name] [version_no]_1 Diagram.lsc *** Paste from clipboard (Only texts can be copied) Additionally, if I use cut, the blocks become unusable.
Has a solution been found for this problem? I am experiencing the same message and result. Thank you in advance. Regards,
Install the latest [version_no] of [product_name]. You can download the upgrade for [product_name] [version_no] and the corresponding service pack from [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Users report inconsistent behavior with copy-paste when using [product_name] [version_no]. While copy-paste functions correctly for older projects migrated to the new version, it often fails for projects created directly in the newer version, producing clipboard-related messages. This leads to frustration due to lost blocks and interrupted workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want reliable copy-paste functionality for logic blocks in all projects, regardless of their creation or modification version history.
